method: R25 fixed R24 data, prior-year outcome calibration of market-implied total (Poisson) and home goal share (conditional binomial), static level vs static plus log-total/logit-share market changes. Same ridge100 experimental penalty, no tuning to returns. Market-implied uncalibrated reference is scored on outcomes only; its near-tied EV does not determine a trading side. All matched fixtures included, no outcome filtering; history and receipt separate, previously explored, not independent prospective.
